title: Audience Research
meta: Your customer reviews and feedback summarized into clear themes, quotes and marketing ideas. From $100, delivered in 7 days or less.
h1: Audience research from your customer feedback
overview: Your reviews, emails and survey answers hold the words customers use to describe what they want. We read them with AI tools, then a person sorts the results into clear themes: what people love, what puts them off and which questions repeat. You receive a short report with real phrases from your own customers, audience profiles and ideas for headlines, product pages and ads. Personal details are removed before we share anything.

faq: Where does the feedback come from?
Your own reviews, support emails, chat logs, survey results and social comments. You send exports or let us view them as a collaborator. We use only data you own or that is public.
Yes. We remove names, emails and other personal details from the report, and we do not share your data outside the work. Please share only what you are allowed to use under your privacy policy.
No. We do not scrape or resell data. For competitor themes, we read public reviews by hand and summarize them in our own words, within each site's terms.
What if I have very little feedback?
Even 30 or 40 comments can show clear patterns. If you have too few, we tell you and suggest a short survey, so the research is based on real answers, not guesses.
